items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes, always, for athletes, coaches and veterans. No plan, no subscription, no credit card. Free now, free forever.

items.question: Who can see my contact info?
items.answer: No one, until you accept a connection. Companies can request to connect, but your email, phone, and any other contact details are only shared after you say yes.

items.question: How do you check companies?
items.answer: We confirm work email domain, legal business name, and hiring contact. Every company is reviewed by our team before they can post a single job.

items.question: What do veterans need to verify?
items.answer: A quick check of your service — branch, rank, and dates. We never ask for your Social Security number, and any documents you upload are permanently deleted after review.

items.question: What if someone asks me for money?
items.answer: Report it immediately. Companies can never charge you for anything — not to apply, not to get hired, not for training or equipment. Use the flag on their profile or email info@the-nextrep.com.
